layerLegend.UNIVERSE_CANONICAL: Identifier defined by the governed Universe semantic payload.
layerLegend.CROSS_LAYER_CONTRACT: Identifier defined by a governed cross-module contract/crosswalk layer that sits between Universe and daughters.
layerLegend.DAUGHTER_LOCAL: Identifier owned by a daughter module and deterministically derived from that module's own identity.
layerLegend.OPERATIONAL_KNOWLEDGE: Identifier defined by governed Operational Knowledge.
layerLegend.CANONICAL_INFORMATION_OBJECT: Identifier defined by the canonical information/object layer.
layerLegend.ORPHAN: Referenced but not defined or derivable in any governed layer.
